slice-model.text: As a maintainer, I want the model to fail whenever a fold needs an input the chain does not hold.
The three statements are committed failing, then proved over the datum value, then every consumer of the model follows.

slice-wire.text: As Alice, I want my request to carry my datum, so anyone can fold it.
Cage refusal tests are committed failing; the cage destination carries the datum with naming's mirror, identities and vectors; booking and fold use the request's datum; the preimage store is removed.

slice-two-actors.text: As Bob, I want to fold Alice's insertion with none of her files.
Bob's fold is refused for the missing envelope on a tree without the wire slice, then passes on the development network in the job that runs the packaged commands.
